reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "fix: Only set discard logger if debug is false by @simonklb in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6274", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Environments running Crossplane with debug enabled will, after upgrading, no longer have the discard logger set, so debug-mode log output that was previously silently discarded is now produced; nothing fails, but logging output under the same configuration differs.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; after upgrading, verify that debug logging output appears as expected when running with --debug.

proposed.statement: In Crossplane 2.0.0 the discard logger is only set when debug is false, so with debug enabled the discard logger is no longer installed and debug-mode log output that was previously discarded is now emitted.
